task_request: Collect at least 30 books from the first two pages of https://books.toscrape.com with title, numeric price, 1-5 rating, and availability. Create books_report.xlsx with Raw Data, Statistics, and Market Insights sheets, and create stats.json with the requested metrics, price-tier counts, and a concise price-rating insight. Save both outputs in the workspace root.

nodes.objective: Visit exactly the first two catalogue pages of https://books.toscrape.com and extract every displayed book record, yielding at least 30 unique books. For each record capture title, price as a numeric value without the currency symbol, rating converted from the site's word class to an integer from 1 through 5, availability text, source page number, and source URL. Preserve source order, check duplicates and field completeness, and write scraped_books.json as traceability evidence. Do not reconstruct data from model memory.

Read scraped_books.json and create books_report.xlsx with exactly three sheets named Raw Data, Statistics, and Market Insights. Raw Data must contain one row per book with Title, Price, Rating, and Availability; store Price and Rating as numbers, use readable formatting, freeze the header, and enable filters. Statistics must calculate total_books, average_price, max_price, min_price, and in_stock_count using spreadsheet formulas that reference Raw Data so values update automatically. Market Insights must segment Budget (<20), Mid-range (20-40 inclusive), and Premium (>40), with formula-driven count and average rating for each tier. Also write stats.json with the requested seven top-level fields, decimal numeric metrics, price_tiers keys budget/midrange/premium, and a 1-2 sentence market_insight based on the observed price-rating relationship.

Perform bounded read-only validation without repairing artifacts. Confirm books_report.xlsx and stats.json exist in the exact workspace and parse successfully; there are at least 30 unique source-backed books from pages 1 and 2; workbook sheet names are exact; Raw Data rows and numeric types match scraped_books.json; Statistics contains live formulas for all five metrics; Market Insights uses the required tier boundaries and formula-driven counts and average ratings; JSON contains every requested field and its values and tier counts agree with independently recomputed values from the raw records. Report concise PASS/FAIL findings and artifact_unchanged=true.
